How Book NEXUS Works

Seamlessly combining institutional library stock with controlled student rentals.

01
account_balance

100% Free Campus Library

Controlled by College Librarian
  • check_circleCheck real-time stock availability online before visiting library.
  • check_circleBorrow books for free for the number of days set by the College Librarian.
  • check_circleReturns & overdue fines managed exclusively by the Librarian.

storefront

Controlled Student Rentals

Anonymous & Admin Verified
  • shieldStudent identities remain private throughout the rental process, with personal details not exposed to the other party.
  • pinPhysical exchange happens at the Book NEXUS campus pickup center.
  • keyDual OTP verification (Renter OTP & Owner OTP) confirmed by Admin.

List Book for Rental

List your textbook for peer rentals with Book NEXUS pickup verification.

You can also add, change or remove a discount later from My Listed Inventory. Discounts of 40% or more also appear under “Heavy discounts” in Campus Offers.

Choose from the current Book NEXUS offers shown on the Home Page. Offers are set by Book NEXUS; you can only attach them to your listing.

This is how your book will appear to other users. It updates as you type; nothing is published until you submit.

Pickup Center Book NEXUS Pickup Center. Drop-off and collection are verified there; Book NEXUS assigns the counter and handles approval, OTPs and IDs.

Commission agreement. Book NEXUS will retain a 10% commission from the applicable rental amount for each completed rental transaction. The commission is calculated by Book NEXUS.

New to Book NEXUS?

Your name, USN and email are checked against college records. Accounts are created for current students only.

Already have an account?

Book NEXUS has no email service connected, so a code can’t be emailed to you. Confirm your college record details instead to set a new password.

Staff passwords can’t be reset from this screen because no email service is connected. Ask the college administrator to re-issue your staff credentials.

Staff accounts are issued by the college. They can’t be created here.
